meta.note: Hazard footprints available to the scenario engine.
meta.model: Each footprint is a set of weighted centroids with a radius. Intensity falls off from 1.0 inside the inner 60% of the radius to 0 at the edge. This is a coarse screening footprint, NOT a hydrodynamic inundation or landslide-susceptibility model.
meta.severity_note: The severity slider scales these intensities. It is a scenario control - never a probability, a flood depth, or a damage rate.
meta.caveat: Relative district severity for the 2023 event reflects the broad pattern in public post-disaster reporting. Exact per-district intensity values are modelled, not measured.

hazards.name: Himachal Pradesh monsoon floods & landslides
hazards.source: Relative severity informed by HPSDMA post-disaster reporting and the HP Economic Survey 2023-24; per-district intensity values are modelled.
hazards.narrative: Severe monsoon flooding, cloudbursts and landslides across Himachal Pradesh, with the heaviest damage in the Beas basin districts of Mandi and Kullu.

hazards.name: Extreme flood stress test (hypothetical)
hazards.source: Hypothetical stress-test footprint. Does not reconstruct any specific historical event.
hazards.narrative: A hypothetical extreme flood centred on the Solan industrial belt rather than the upper Beas basin, used to stress the pharma manufacturing cluster directly.
